name: SForum SMTP
description: Protected built-in SMTP mail delivery provider.

zh.name: SForum SMTP
zh.description: 受保护的内置 SMTP 邮件发送提供方。

settings.label: SMTP 服务器 / SMTP host
settings.description: 邮件服务商提供的服务器地址，例如 smtp.example.com。 / Server hostname from your mail provider.

settings.label: 加密方式 / Encryption
settings.description: 推荐 STARTTLS + 587；TLS/SSL 常用 465；无加密仅适合可信内网。 / STARTTLS with port 587 is recommended; TLS/SSL commonly uses 465; none is for trusted networks only.

settings.label: 端口 / Port
settings.description: STARTTLS 推荐 587，TLS/SSL 推荐 465，无加密通常为 25。 / Use 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS/SSL, or usually 25 for none.

settings.label: 用户名 / Username
settings.description: 通常是完整邮箱地址。 / Usually your full email address.

settings.label: 密码 / Password
settings.description: 多数邮箱服务需要应用专用密码。留空会保留现有密码。 / Most providers require an app password. Leave blank to preserve the current password.
settings.placeholder: 应用专用密码 / App password

settings.label: 发件邮箱 / From address
settings.description: 收件人看到的发件地址，通常应与认证账号或已验证域名一致。 / Visible sender address; usually matches the account or a verified domain.

settings.label: 发件名称 / From name
settings.description: 建议填写站点名称。 / The site name is recommended.
